notes.title: Summit Drive Demo Update Version 1.3.5
notes.notes:
What was updated?Main Menu:
Main menu music added into the game

Camera pans closer to character when played

Option to select different mountain/maps has been added in preparation for the release

Version number added at the bottom of the screen

Fonts were changed due to copyright restrictions
Additional Updates:
Thomas Perrone will be doing the composition/OST for Summit Drive

Credit was added into the game
Bug Fixes:
Decreased collider of some trees found at the top of the mountain

Adjusted van hitbox

Fixed animation error on player(bird)

Pixelation effect does not reset when restarting the game
